headline: Mid‑cap Indian IT firms posted strong revenue growth while large players saw modest gains and mixed profit trends.
summary: Coforge led the quarter with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM and Tech Mahindra also delivered double‑digit growth. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the slowest among peers. Profit margins were mixed, with HCLTech and TCS expanding, while Infosys and Wipro saw profit pressure.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin guidance shifts
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance, whereas Coforge raised its EBIT margin target to 16%.

themes.title: Mid‑cap growth surge
themes.detail: Coforge, LTM and Tech Mahindra posted the highest YoY revenue growth, outpacing the larger peers.
